title: Safeguards to Ensure Suitability of Adults who Foster or Adopt Children who Have Endured Traumatic Past
what_it_is: Safeguards to Ensure Suitability of Adults who Foster or Adopt Children who Have Endured Traumatic Past

sections.label: Adoption Suitability Assessment stage
sections.summary: During the first stage, prospective adopters must undergo a comprehensive Adoption Suitability Assessment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: During the first stage, prospective adopters must undergo a comprehensive Adoption Suitability Assessment.

sections.label: Children's homes staff training and screening
sections.summary: Children's homes staff receive compulsory abuse-recognition training and are screened for criminal records before contact with children, and the home followed these procedures.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Social workers and professionals employed at our children homes receive compulsory training to recognise signs and symptoms of sexual and other forms of abuse.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Staff, volunteers and personnel engaged by children's homes are screened for prior criminal records before they have contact with children.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In the recently reported case, these procedures were followed by the home.

sections.label: Kith caregiver background checks
sections.summary: Trained professionals conduct background checks and assessments before a kith caregiver is identified, and MSF checked the man and his wife.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: For kith caregivers, before a caregiver is identified to provide care for a child or a young person under MSF's care, like I have mentioned before, background checks and assessments are conducted by trained professionals.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: For this particular case, MSF had conducted background checks on the man and his wife before they were identified as caregivers for the child.

sections.label: Volunteer suitability assessments and background checks
sections.summary: All volunteers in MSF-funded programmes with client contact must undergo suitability assessments and background checks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: From what I understand, the sexual abuse was between the period of September 2020 and November 2020, whereas the interactions that the child had with this caregiver started in 2019.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Coming back to volunteers, which was another aspect of the Member's question, I had mentioned before that all volunteers in MSF-funded programmes who have contact with clients, will need to undergo suitability assessments and background checks.

sections.label: Domestic violence decision-making tools
sections.summary: MSF will progressively launch tools for a more robust and consistent decision-making system for the domestic violence sector.

sentences.text: MSF will progressively be launching a suite of tools to ensure a more robust and consistent decision-making system for the domestic violence sector.

So, this is something that we are working on to make sure that not only has there been training provided to social service professionals, but that there are standardised assessment tools so that the social service professionals know what the baselines are and under what circumstances to report.

sections.label: Family and Domestic Violence Awareness Training
sections.summary: MSF has rolled out its Family and Domestic Violence Awareness Training, part of the Break the Silence campaign, reaching 7,550 individuals.

sentences.text: MSF has been very active in rolling out MSF's Family and Domestic Violence Awareness Training, which is part of the Break the Silence campaign.
We have reached out to 7,550 individuals, which include preschool teachers, students at the National Institute of Education (NIE), teachers in our foreign system schools.

sections.label: Family violence awareness training rollout
sections.summary: MSF's family and domestic violence awareness training has been rolled out, engaging 7,550 individuals, many of whom are teachers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the first point, the MSF's family and domestic violence awareness training has been rolled out.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I mentioned that we have engaged 7,550 individuals, many of whom are teachers.

sections.label: Clinical and Forensic Psychology Services team
sections.summary: A specialised Clinical and Forensic Psychology Services team provides psychological services to children, youths and families, understanding trauma and abuse profiles.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the second point, we have a specialised division called the Clinical and Forensic Psychology Services team which provides specialised psychological services to children, youths and their family, and in particular, they have a good understanding of how to understand the profile and needs of children who have undergone trauma and abuse, and how to communicate with these children and their families.

sections.label: Improving home check-in protocol
sections.summary: The question asks how the home is improving its protocol, recognising constant or daily check-ins are too resource-intensive.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin
sentences.text: How is the home looking at improving its current protocol, recognising that constant, or even daily check-ins, are too resource-intensive?

sections.label: Hand signal for help
sections.summary: A hand signal for help was rolled out so children can disclose abuse and reach the National Anti-Violence and Sexual Harassment helpline or Social Service Offices.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: At the same time, I would also like to share that we had rolled out the hand signal for help because we want to make sure that whether there is opportunity for the child to be in the community and should he or she decide to disclose this abuse, that he or she is able to reach out for help.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We hope that members of the public will recognise what the sign means and please call the National Anti-Violence and Sexual Harassment helpline or reach out to Social Service Offices' or our protection specialist centres, so that help can be given to this survivor victim of family violence as soon as possible.

sections.label: Pre-adoption briefing and suitability assessment
sections.summary: Prospective adopters must attend a pre-adoption briefing and undergo a comprehensive Adoption Suitability Assessment conducted by MSF-accredited agency social service staff.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In general, for prospective adopters, what happens in the process is that they first have to attend a pre-adoption briefing and they have to undergo a comprehensive Adoption Suitability Assessment which is conducted by social service staff from an MSF-accredited adoption agency.

sections.label: Adoption assessment for traumatic history
sections.summary: Prospective adopters of children with traumatic history must be assessed for complex care needs, with input from the Clinical and Forensic Psychology Service team.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: At the stage of pre-adoption requirements, I had mentioned that the prospective adopter has to undergo a comprehensive Adoption Suitability Assessment and prospective adopters who wish to adopt a child with a traumatic history, will need to be assessed if they are able to meet the child's complex care needs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, it is one layer above what I shared earlier.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I had also shared that we have a specialised Clinical and Forensic Psychology Service team.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: They have the expertise, given that they have dealt with children with a traumatic history before.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, their input will also be taken in.
